what: The browser session this slice ran, lifted out of the assistant campaign's own process table — a committed artifact of that campaign whose checks describe it — and the campaign's file restored to its committed bytes below.
ownershipRule: session-name prefix (qa-*, look-sweep-*) in %USERPROFILE%\.agent-browser\<session>.pid, then PID + creation time + executable re-read from the live process table
shutdownCommand: node scripts/fast-cdp-test.mjs <session> .temp/live-rig/scenarios/close-campaign.json  (the CLI's own `close`, not a kill)

devServer.what: owned dev server 127.0.0.1:8085 — vite, a separate origin so the assistant's stored state is isolated from the user's
devServer.stoppedBy: .temp/live-rig/server-8085.ps1 -Stop — executable, command line and creation time re-read from the live process table and compared to the ownership record before anything was terminated
devServer.exitVerified: PID 50804 gone, port 8085 released, the user-facing preview on :8080 still listening
devServer.cleanupLog: Stopped owned dev server. Verified processes terminated: 84376. Port 8085 released.
